diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE literal, return-type, numeric-expression, string-concatenation, and project signature model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully. It is red because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13 for nonnumeric string literals passed to numeric parameters, and runtime error 6 for decimal literals outside Byte/Integer argument bounds, while numeric-string and min/max boundary controls run successfully. Cross-module checks use exported standard-module project Sub/Function/Declare signatures; ambiguous bare names stay silent, while module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only. Source-backed and host member signatures feed the same argument type path for parenthesized calls and parenless member call statements.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: VBA Function/Property Get return-variable semantics plus XLIDE type-safety policy
diagnostics.notes: VBA permits a Function or Property Get to fall through without assigning its return variable, which returns the default value for the declared type. XLIDE surfaces this as a warning, not a compile-equivalent error.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error when the receiver resolves to a workbook class and source proves the member has no setter. Public constants are not object members in VBE; public constant declarations in object modules fail at the declaration.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic source-backed project class member model
diagnostics.notes: This is a VBE compile-equivalent error for workbook class receivers whose source-backed member surface is known and unambiguous. Public fields are valid members. Host/object-model and ambiguous receiver cases remain silent unless the receiver surface is exhaustive. Host events are not callable object members, so event names are excluded from object-member surfaces and can be reported absent when the receiver surface is exhaustive. Object and Variant receivers remain silent even when completion can refine them from simple Set assignments because VBE leaves those calls late-bound.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE literal-divisor expression scan
diagnostics.notes: This is an error but not VBE compile-equivalent: focused runtime oracle cases show /, integer division, and Mod by decimal, hexadecimal, octal, module-Const, local-Const, reducible integer Const-expression, and current-module Enum member zero divisors compile successfully and deterministically raise runtime error 11, while nonzero literal, Const-expression, and Enum member controls run. Const/Enum folding includes decimal/hex/octal integer literals and implicit Enum successor values where the expression remains deterministic. The active rule scans settled procedure statements, including nested expressions, and remains conservative for variables, unresolved constants, cross-module enum values, and broader expression folding until flow/reachability handling is broader.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1
Excel/VBE compile oracle plus verified runtime metadata for explicit Call compatibility
diagnostics.notes: VBE rejects DoEvents as an explicit Call target both with and without empty parentheses, but accepts bare DoEvents as a statement and DoEvents() in expression context. XLIDE records this as runtime-call metadata so diagnostics, identifier completion, and signature help share one rule.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases for standalone empty-parentheses calls without Call
diagnostics.notes: VBE rejects standalone zero-argument calls such as myFunction(), DoEvents(), ThisWorkbook.CanCheckIn(), Application.Calculate(), and ActiveSheet.Range() when they use empty parentheses without Call, while the same parenthesized call is valid in expression context. Known same-module and exported standard-module procedures are resolved through the project procedure surface; unknown bare Foo() calls stay silent to avoid external-reference false positives. Explicit Call remains valid for ordinary procedures and member calls, but runtime entries can opt out through shared runtime metadata when oracle evidence proves a special form such as DoEvents. VBE also accepts non-empty standalone member/property forms such as Application.DeleteCustomList(1) and ActiveSheet.Range("A1"), so the active member-call rule is deliberately scoped to the empty-parentheses form.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 5.6.9
MS-VBAL 5.6 expression syntax plus VBE Syntax error behavior for impossible operator sequences and incomplete member access
diagnostics.notes: Active coverage is deliberately narrow: consecutive non-unary binary operators such as ***, statements ending with a binary operator, unsupported '?' conditional-operator syntax, and oracle-backed incomplete member access forms such as ThisWorkbook. or a bare . inside an active With block. The IIf compile-valid oracle control confirms the supported inline conditional form remains accepted; separate runtime oracle cases prove IIf branch evaluation behavior for future deterministic-runtime diagnostics. Live diagnostics suppress incomplete member-access errors while the cursor remains on the active edit line; current-module and workbook validation still report the settled final source.
